definitions.explanation: The practice of maintaining cleanliness and health, or the conditions and standards that promote good health and prevent disease.

examples.english: Washing your hands is the basis of hygiene.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{飲食店|いんしょくてん}→飲食店：15093_inshokuten⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{衛生|えいせい}{管理|かんり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{徹底|てってい}している→徹底する：21452_tetteisuru⟧。
examples.english: This restaurant has thorough hygiene management.

notes:
USAGE:
A practical, everyday word used in food service, healthcare, public health, and daily life. Not to be confused with the homophone ⟦{衛星|えいせい}→衛星：01880_eisei⟧ (satellite).
